tokyo_kaminarimon_sansada_sans.price_note: Six tempura dishes with prices from the shop’s own menu page; the page describes the contents of each but does not extend to rice bowls, sides or drinks, so this is the tempura board rather than the whole menu. Tabelog not consulted: it has served Cf-Mitigated: challenge (HTTP 403) to this egress since 2026-09-02. ⚠ THE ONE THING THIS SHOP SAYS THAT CHANGES A DIET ANSWER IS ABOUT THE OIL, NOT THE FLOUR: 「胡麻油で揚げる伝統を今に伝える」 — it fries in SESAME OIL, in the old Edo style. That matters twice over. For a coeliac it changes nothing at all: the batter is still wheat flour and the tentsuyu is still soy and dashi, so the whole board is closed. But SESAME is one of Japan’s designated allergens in its own right, and a shop that fries everything in sesame oil is a hazard for a sesame allergy that no dish name would reveal — worth recording because this dataset’s users travel with more than one restriction. ⚠ THERE IS NOTHING HERE FOR EITHER DIET. Every item is battered; 季節の野菜天ぷら at ¥1,940 is six seasonal vegetables and is vegetarian in filling and wheat in coating, which is the same near-miss the vegetable tempura at every other shop in this set produces. ⚠ ONE PRACTICAL NOTE: the 大かき揚 at ¥8,000 is offered but the shop warns 混雑時はお受け出来ない場合もございます — it may be refused at busy times.

tokyo_bistro_aligot.price_note: ⚠ THE OPERATOR ITSELF SAYS THESE PRICES ARE UNRELIABLE RIGHT NOW, so this is partial on the shop’s own instruction, not on doubt about the source. 夢屋’s page for 【神保町】ビストロアリゴ heads its food list «Menu Example ※価格表示については現在修正中です» — a menu EXAMPLE with prices currently being revised — and closes with ※価格は税抜です。材料入荷の関係でメニュー内容・価格が多少変動する場合がございます. So every food price below is PRE-TAX and provisional; add 10% for what you will actually pay. The course prices carry no 税抜 marker of their own but sit under the same footnote. There is also a stale line to ignore: the page still advertises the 4,000 yen premium course as starting 2024年10月1日. Aligot is a 55-seat rustic French place in a 55-year-old wooden house in a Jimbocho backstreet, with standing, tatami and private rooms, run by Yumeya (which also runs a gibier distribution business — hence the wild boar). ⚠ NO ALLERGEN INFORMATION IS PUBLISHED AND FRENCH BISTRO COOKING IS A FLOUR KITCHEN: 煮込みハンバーグ is panko-bound in a flour-thickened sauce, the カスレ carries a house sausage (rusk filler) and is normally crumb-gratinated, and the コロッケ is breaded. アリゴ itself — the Auvergnat potato-and-tomme purée the shop is named for — is potato, cheese, butter and garlic with no flour in the classical recipe, but the shop states no ingredients, so it is ask. The 鶏もも肉のロティ and the スペアリブ煮込み are the other two worth asking about.

tokyo_ramen_butayama_sakura_st.price_note: Full chain grand menu from ラーメン豚山’s own メニュー page — all prices 税込 as printed — attached to the サクラステージ店 shop page (渋谷区桜丘町1-4, 渋谷サクラステージ SHIBUYA サイド 1F). The chain caveat 「一部店舗では取り扱いのないメニューがある場合や価格が異なる場合がございます」 applies, hence partial. This is a Jiro-style (二郎系) shop and the numbers matter: 小 is 250 g of noodle, ミニ 125 g, 大 375 g, and the chain warns its own 小 is about the size of an ordinary shop’s 大盛 and tells first-timers to order ミニ or 小. ⚠ NOTHING IN THIS SHOP IS GLUTEN-FREE AND THE FREE-TOPPING RITUAL DOES NOT CHANGE THAT. 極太麺 is thick wheat noodle, the tare is soy, and the pork is soy-braised; the 汁なし, つけ麺 and 冷やし中華 variants are the same noodle with more soy. The chain DOES publish an アレルギー表・産地情報 PDF at https://butayama.com/allergy/ and it IS a real allergen table, but it is a graphical scan whose Japanese product names and marks do not extract as text, so nothing below is drawn from it. ⚠ THE CALL SYSTEM IS THE ONE THING A VISITOR SHOULD PRE-LEARN, and the shop prints the exact quantities: garlic 抜き 0 g / 少し half a tablespoon / ニンニク one tablespoon / マシマシ two tablespoons; vegetables 少なめ 150 g / 標準 300 g / マシ 450 g / マシマシ 600 g; back fat 標準 / アブラ / アブラマシマシ; tare strength 標準 / カラメ / カラカラ. Calls are taken just before the bowl is handed over; 麺硬め must be said earlier, when the ticket is collected. ⚠ SEASONAL LINES: つけ麺 is sold 1 April to 30 September and 冷やし中華 1 June to 30 September only.

tokyo_niku_bistro_akari.price_note: ALMOST EMPTY ON PURPOSE, AND THE REASON IS WORTH RECORDING. 肉ビストロ灯 (西新宿7-16-3 第18フジビル 2F, Zekkocho group) does publish its full Food, Drink and Course menus — but only as three image-scan PDFs linked from its Menu page (20260217_Food_Menu.pdf, 20260217_Drink_Menu.pdf, course.pdf, all dated by the 2026.02.17 グランドメニューが新しくなりました news item). pdftotext returns one byte from each: they carry no text layer, and this machine has no pdftoppm to render the pages, so NOT ONE DISH NAME OR PRICE COULD BE READ. The single price the site states in HTML is the お通し at 660 yen (税込), recorded below because it is compulsory. What the site does describe in words, and which is worth knowing before booking: the kitchen serves 6-8 different 塊肉 (whole-block cuts) a day — beef, pork, lamb and gibier including venison and wild boar — seared over 備長炭 charcoal and served rare in the middle, alongside a locked wine cellar of roughly 100-150 bottles that guests walk into with a lantern. No allergen information is published anywhere. Anyone re-running this record needs either a PDF rasteriser or the shop’s own reservation line.
